integrity: Exact theorem is proved in RESULT.md; the shifted-covariance lemma is credited to prior literature. A standalone finite numerical checker supplements the proof, without certifying universal claims.
scientific_limitations: The sharp modulus and optimizer classification concern only coordinate-separable normalized Gaussian quotient densities on orthogonal lattices, not all possible lifts or general quadratic forms. Numerical decimals are approximations; independent audit is not performed.
title: Sharp theta-curvature envelope for Gaussian lifts of rectangular lattices
